title: Your account
description: How you sign in, and how Conversa looks for you. These settings follow you into every workspace.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name is shown to your teammates and in the audit log.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: Your sign-in address. It cannot be changed here.
profile.languageHint: Used for the app and for the emails Conversa sends you.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.label: Theme
theme.systemDescription: Follows the light or dark setting of this device.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs you out on every other device.
password.newHint: At least 12 characters. A few unrelated words work well.
password.changedDescription: Your other devices were signed out.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Asks for a code from an authenticator app each time you sign in, so a stolen password is not enough.
mfa.offDescription: Use an app such as 1Password, Google Authenticator or Authy.
mfa.onDescription: You are asked for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in. A recovery code works too.
mfa.scanTitle: 1. Add Conversa to your authenticator app
mfa.scanDescription: Scan this code with the app. If you cannot scan it, enter the setup key instead.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code for adding Conversa to an authenticator app
mfa.codeTitle: 2. Enter the code the app shows
mfa.recoveryDescription: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them in a password manager or print them. They are shown only now.
mfa.disableDescription: Signing in will only need your password. Enter it to confirm.

sessions.title: Where you are signed in
sessions.description: Sign out of any device you do not recognise, then change your password.
sessions.label: Active sessions
